en_us.gui.hbm.snowglobe.rivetcity.inscription: Welcome to Rivet City. Please wait while the bridge extends.
en_us.gui.hbm.snowglobe.tenpennytower.name: Tenpenny Tower
en_us.gui.hbm.snowglobe.tenpennytower.inscript: Tenpenny Tower is the brainchild of Allistair Tenpenny, a British refugee who came to the Capital Wasteland seeking his fortune.
en_us.gui.hbm.snowglobe.lucky38.name: Lucky 38
en_us.gui.hbm.snowglobe.lucky38.inscription: My guess? Leads to a big cashout at some casino - and if the "38" on it is any indication... well... Lucky 38 it is.
en_us.gui.hbm.snowglobe.sierramadre.name: Sierra Madre
en_us.gui.hbm.snowglobe.sierramadre.inscriptio: It's the moment you've been waiting for, the reason we're all here - the Gala Event, the Grand Opening of the Sierra Madre Casino.

en_us.gui.hbm.snowglobe.prydwen.inscription: People of the Commonwealth. Do not interfere. Our intentions are peaceful. We are the Brotherhood of Steel.

zh_cn.gui.hbm.snowglobe.tenpennytower.name: 十便士塔
zh_cn.gui.hbm.snowglobe.tenpennytower.inscript: 十便士塔由阿利斯泰尔·十便士一手创立。这位英国难民来到首都废土，寻求属于自己的财富。
zh_cn.gui.hbm.snowglobe.lucky38.name: 幸运38
zh_cn.gui.hbm.snowglobe.lucky38.inscription: 依我看？那地方能让人在赌场大赚一笔。如果名字里的“38”有什么含义……嗯……那就是幸运38。
zh_cn.gui.hbm.snowglobe.sierramadre.name: 马德雷山庄
zh_cn.gui.hbm.snowglobe.sierramadre.inscriptio: 你翘首以盼的时刻终于到了，也是我们齐聚于此的原因——盛大庆典，马德雷山庄赌场的隆重开幕。
zh_cn.gui.hbm.snowglobe.prydwen.name: 普利德温号
zh_cn.gui.hbm.snowglobe.prydwen.inscription: 联邦的居民们，不要干涉。我们的来意是和平的。我们是钢铁兄弟会。
